use_cases.name: Automate probation reviews and outcomes
use_cases.goal: Schedule probation reviews ahead of the due date, collect the manager's assessment and drive confirm, extend or separate outcomes with the right letters.

stakeholders.interest: Gets a timely decision and a letter, not an indefinite probation.
Confirmation-linked pay or benefit changes take effect on the right date.

use_cases.trigger: An employee's probation end date is 30 days away.
preconditions: The assignment carries a probation end date and the policy for review lead time and allowed extensions.
Letter templates for confirmation, extension and separation exist per entity.
postconditions_success: The outcome is recorded with an effective date, the assignment is updated and the letter is issued and acknowledged.
postconditions_failure: An overdue review is escalated; the employee's status does not change silently.

main_flow.action: Thirty days before probation ends for E1066 Abhinav Rastogi, opens a review task for manager E1039.
Notifies the manager and HR with the due date and the assessment form.
Completes the assessment: objectives met, conduct, attendance summary and recommendation to confirm.
Attaches attendance and leave facts for the probation period to the assessment.
Reviews the recommendation and routes it for approval.
Approves confirmation.
Writes the confirmation as a new assignment version effective on the probation end date and queues any benefit changes.
Generates the confirmation letter, sends it for e-signature and records acknowledgement.

steps: The manager states reason and extension length within policy; the new end date is set and a fresh review is scheduled.
The case routes to HR and the director; on approval, a separation letter is issued and exit is initiated.

exception_flows.condition: The manager has not submitted by the due date.
exception_flows.handling: The task escalates to the manager's manager and HR; status remains on probation.

exception_flows.condition: A requested extension exceeds the maximum allowed by policy.
exception_flows.handling: The extension is refused and the manager must confirm or recommend separation.

nfrs: Review tasks are created for 100% of probations ending in the next 30 days by 06:00 daily.
A letter is generated within 30 s of approval.

user_stories.want: a probation review task 30 days before it is due
user_stories.so_that: I decide in time instead of letting probation lapse

acceptance.given: E1066 joined on 2026-09-01 with 6 months probation ending 2027-02-28
acceptance.then: I receive a review task due 2027-02-28

acceptance.given: I have not submitted by 2027-02-28
acceptance.then: the task escalates to my manager and HR

user_stories.want: the approved outcome to update the assignment and generate the letter
user_stories.so_that: confirmation is consistent across records and documents

acceptance.given: confirmation is approved
acceptance.then: the assignment shows confirmed from 2027-03-01 and the letter is sent for e-signature

acceptance.given: an extension of 3 months with a 3-month policy maximum
acceptance.then: the probation end date becomes 2027-05-31 and a new review is scheduled

user_stories.want: to receive my confirmation letter in self-service
user_stories.so_that: I have proof of my confirmed status

acceptance.given: my confirmation is approved
acceptance.then: it appears in my documents and asks for my acknowledgement

acceptance.given: I acknowledge the letter
acceptance.then: the acknowledgement time is recorded on the letter

use_cases.name: Convert a contract or trainee worker to permanent
use_cases.goal: Convert a contract or trainee worker to permanent employment with service continuity rules, revised worker class and statutory re-registration.

stakeholders.interest: Keeps the right service continuity for leave, gratuity and seniority.
Pay, statutory deductions and leave entitlements switch on the correct date.
Statutory registrations transfer or are re-registered correctly.

use_cases.trigger: A manager or HR proposes conversion, for example trainee E1030 Chetan Bhandary on completion of training.
preconditions: The person exists once and keeps the same person identifier across the conversion.
A vacant permanent position exists at the site.
Service continuity rules per source worker class are configured.
postconditions_success: A new assignment with worker class WC-PERM is effective from the conversion date; service continuity, leave entitlements and statutory registrations are updated and the letter is issued.
postconditions_failure: The person remains in the original worker class with no partial change.

main_flow.action: Proposes conversion of E1030 from WC-TRN to WC-PERM at Peenya Machining effective 2026-12-01.
Checks the target permanent position is vacant and computes service continuity under the configured rule.
Shows the impact: new leave entitlements, statutory deductions, pay structure and continuity date.
Reviews the impact and routes the conversion for approval.
Approves the conversion.
Ends the trainee assignment, creates the permanent assignment on the same person and queues attendance recompute.
Opens statutory steps in the chain, such as updating the UAN record and nomination forms.
Generates the appointment letter and the revised nomination forms for signature.

alternate_flows.condition: The worker is a third-party employee of vendor VN-01.
steps: Conversion is handled as a new hire into LE-01 with person adoption; contractor service is recorded but not counted as continuous service unless policy states otherwise.

exception_flows.handling: Conversion cannot proceed until a position is created within sanctioned strength.

exception_flows.condition: A statutory step is not completed within its SLA.
exception_flows.handling: The step escalates to the compliance owner; the employee's pay continues under the new class.

nfrs: The impact preview is shown in under 3 s.
Conversion never creates a second person record.

user_stories.want: to see the impact of a conversion before approval
user_stories.so_that: I know how leave, pay and statutory treatment will change

acceptance.given: E1030 is a trainee entitled only to CL
acceptance.when: I preview conversion to WC-PERM from 2026-12-01
acceptance.then: the preview shows EL, CL and SL entitlements, the permanent pay structure and the continuity date

acceptance.given: no permanent position is vacant at Peenya Machining
acceptance.then: conversion is blocked with the position status named

user_stories.want: my service to count from my original joining date where policy allows
user_stories.so_that: my gratuity and leave are not reset

acceptance.given: a continuity rule counting trainee service for WC-TRN
acceptance.when: E1030 is converted on 2026-12-01 having joined on 2026-07-01
acceptance.then: the continuity date is 2026-07-01

acceptance.given: the conversion completes
acceptance.then: I see one employee code and worker class Permanent

user_stories.so_that: registrations match the new worker class

acceptance.given: E1030 is converted
acceptance.then: steps for the UAN update and nomination forms are created with owners and SLAs

acceptance.given: a step is not done within its SLA
acceptance.then: it escalates to me

use_cases.name: Compute notice period, shortfall and buy-out
use_cases.goal: Compute notice period, shortfall, buy-out amount and leave adjustment for a separating employee and feed the result to full-and-final settlement.

stakeholders.interest: Knows exactly how much notice is owed and what a buy-out will cost.
Can agree an early release with a clear cost.
Receives a final, approved notice settlement amount for full and final.

use_cases.trigger: An employee submits a resignation or the employer issues a termination notice.
preconditions: Notice period rules per worker class, band and status (probation or confirmed) are configured.
The leave ledger and salary structure are current.
postconditions_success: Notice period, last working day, shortfall, buy-out or recovery amount and any leave adjustment are approved and passed to full-and-final settlement.
postconditions_failure: If the computation cannot be finalised, settlement remains held with the reason recorded.

main_flow.action: Submits resignation on 2026-11-02 requesting last working day 2026-11-19.
Resolves required notice from the employee's class and band, for example 30 days, ending 2026-12-01.
Computes the shortfall of 12 days and the buy-out amount on the configured salary basis.
Shows options: serve full notice, buy out the shortfall, or offset shortfall against earned leave where policy allows.
Chooses to offset 5 days against earned leave and buy out 7 days.
Approves the early release and the arrangement.
Confirms the final last working day and the computed amounts.
Debits the leave ledger and passes the notice recovery line to the full-and-final settlement.

steps: The waiver is recorded with reason and approver; no recovery line is created.

alternate_flows.condition: The employer terminates with pay in lieu of notice.
steps: The platform computes notice pay as an earning instead of a recovery.

exception_flows.condition: The employee's earned-leave balance is less than the requested offset.
exception_flows.handling: The offset is capped at the balance and the remainder is added to the buy-out.

exception_flows.condition: A blocking clearance item is still open on the last working day.
exception_flows.handling: Settlement stays on hold until it is closed or waived.

nfrs: Notice computation is returned in under 2 s.
Buy-out amounts are computed in integer paise and reproduced identically in settlement.

user_stories.want: to see my notice shortfall and buy-out cost before I confirm
user_stories.so_that: I can choose the best option

acceptance.given: I am E1051 at Medchal Works with 30 days notice, resigning on 2026-11-02 and requesting LWD 2026-11-19
acceptance.then: I see a 12-day shortfall and its buy-out amount

acceptance.given: I have 5 days of earned leave
acceptance.then: the offset is capped at 5 and 7 days are added to the buy-out

user_stories.want: the approved notice result passed to full and final
user_stories.so_that: I do not recompute it by hand

acceptance.given: a 7-day buy-out approved for E1051
acceptance.then: a notice recovery line with the approved amount appears

acceptance.given: the shortfall is waived by the manager
acceptance.then: no notice recovery line appears and the waiver is referenced

user_stories.want: to approve an early release with the cost shown

acceptance.given: E1051 asks to leave on 2026-11-19
acceptance.then: I see the shortfall, buy-out amount and leave offset

acceptance.given: I approve
acceptance.then: the last working day is set to 2026-11-19

use_cases.name: Complete a knowledge-transfer plan before exit clearance
use_cases.goal: Ensure an exiting employee completes a structured hand-over plan covering documents, access and responsibilities, approved by the manager before clearance closes.

stakeholders.interest: Critical knowledge and responsibilities are handed over before the person leaves.
Clearance closes on time with evidence of hand-over.
Access held by the leaver is transferred or revoked.

use_cases.trigger: A resignation is accepted and the notice period starts.
preconditions: A hand-over template exists for the employee's role family.
The clearance checklist is instantiated for the leaver (RL-400).
postconditions_success: The hand-over plan is completed and approved; responsibilities and documents are reassigned and the knowledge-transfer clearance item is closed.
postconditions_failure: The clearance item remains open and, if blocking, holds settlement until completed or waived.

main_flow.action: Creates a hand-over plan for E1068 Dinesh Vaidya from the engineering template when the resignation is accepted.
Pre-fills open approvals, owned documents, system access and recurring responsibilities held by the leaver.
Names a successor for each item and adds hand-over notes and sessions.
Reviews the plan, adjusts successors and approves it.
Records completion of each hand-over item with the successor's acknowledgement.
Reassigns pending approvals and document ownership to the named successors.
Signs off the completed plan.
Closes the knowledge-transfer clearance item.

alternate_flows.condition: The leaver's role has no successor yet.
steps: The manager is named as interim owner for each item.

exception_flows.condition: The plan is not signed off by the last working day.
exception_flows.handling: The clearance item stays open; if blocking, settlement is held until it is closed or waived by an authorised role.
The item returns to the manager for reassignment.

nfrs: Pre-filled hand-over items are generated within 1 minute of resignation acceptance.
No pending approval assigned to a leaver remains unrouted after the last working day.

user_stories.want: a hand-over plan pre-filled with what the leaver owns
user_stories.so_that: nothing is forgotten when they leave

acceptance.given: E1068 owns 3 open approvals and 12 engineering documents
acceptance.then: the plan lists all 15 items for successor assignment

acceptance.given: I approve the plan with successor E1005 for documents
acceptance.then: document ownership moves to E1005

user_stories.want: a clear checklist of what to hand over
user_stories.so_that: I can leave knowing my work is covered

acceptance.given: my plan has 15 items
acceptance.when: I record completion with successor acknowledgement
acceptance.then: each item shows completed with the date

acceptance.given: a successor declines an item
acceptance.then: my manager is asked to reassign it

user_stories.want: clearance to wait for the hand-over sign-off
user_stories.so_that: knowledge transfer is not skipped to close exit faster

acceptance.given: the knowledge-transfer item is configured as blocking for engineering roles
acceptance.when: the plan is unsigned on LWD 2026-09-30
acceptance.then: full and final remains on hold

acceptance.given: an authorised HR head waives the item with a reason
acceptance.then: the clearance item closes and settlement can proceed
